It filters out noise and lets you focus on the meaningful changes in price. There is no time element in a point and figure chart. It simply measures price changes of a certain size. This is called the price interval. The x-axis is blank. In the PDF, I show a point and figure chart I made for Tesla on December 18th 2020. The day Tesla was added to the S&P 500.
